question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Abandon
solution: The correct answer is: **Relinquish** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Abandon **means to give up or leave behind. (छोड़ देना या पीछे छोड़ देना) • **For example**: *He decided to abandon the old, broken-down car in the middle of the desert and continue his journey on foot.* • **Relinquish **is a synonym of "abandon," meaning to voluntarily give up or let go of something. (किसी चीज़ को स्वेच्छा से त्यागना या जाने देना) • **For example**: *After years of trying to fix the old car, he finally decided to relinquish it to the junkyard.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Construct **means to build or create something, which is the opposite of "abandon." (कुछ बनाना) • **Cherish **means to hold dear or value something greatly, which is the opposite of "abandon." (किसी चीज़ को बहुत प्रिय या महत्व देना) • **Toleration **means to allow or endure something, which is not related to "abandon." (किसी चीज़ की अनुमति देना या सहना) 43:T722, The correct answer is: **BCAD**
